title: 722. Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Transaction Fee

examples.explanation: Buy at 1, sell at 8 (profit 5), then buy at 4 and sell at 9 (profit 3) for 8 total.
One round trip from 1 to 10 nets 9 minus the 3 fee.
Prices only fall, so skipping every trade is best.

hints: Track two states per day: the best balance holding a share and the best balance holding cash.
Holding updates from yesterday's hold or today's cash minus the price; cash updates from yesterday's cash or today's hold plus price minus fee.
Start holding at -prices[0] and cash at 0; the cash state at the end is the answer.
